scripts.dev:services: concurrently --names speech-api,app-api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green,blue "pnpm run dev:speech" "pnpm run dev:app" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:app: cd app-api && source ../.venv311/bin/activate && SPEECH_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 python app.py
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:unit:api && pnpm run test:unit:web
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter web exec rm -rf dist node_modules/.vite
